matchedConditions: 1280x800, device scale 1, same Chromium version, High, day cycle off, exact same player position and camera; hours 16.5 and 23.9. See comparison-verification.json.
observations: Both final v0.8 captures show a complete rendered skyline and foreground without a black frame or an obvious broad color/tone-mapping shift from v0.7.
The near promenade wall has stronger narrow contact shading along its foot, especially in the daytime view; the open sky and distant facade colors remain similar.
No large dirty silhouette halo is apparent in the reviewed daytime or nighttime stills.
The distant ridge silhouette changes slightly because v0.8 moves the terrain east to support the expanded walkable shore; the comparison uses identical camera coordinates.
The large skyline remains recognizably the same procedural scene. These images support a localized shading improvement, not a claim that the overall city has become photorealistic.
limits: Still images do not prove absence of temporal flicker or validate every other camera angle.
Traffic, water and boats were not locked to the same animation frame. Simulation timestamps are recorded.
Captures used software WebGL while other tests were also running. Recorded FPS and timings are diagnostics, not a hardware performance comparison.
The sea and repeated facade patterns remain stylized; these captures do not demonstrate AAA art quality.
primaryConclusion: These matched harbor images primarily support visual regression stability across the v0.8 rendering changes. The local contact-shadow change at the promenade wall is visible, but the evidence does not show a substantial improvement in overall city art quality.
